summary: Implemented `cycle-15-actuation-intent-retrieval-expansion`. The canonicalizer now emits one additive alternate for explicit installed-electric actuator intent and one for actuator-ready intent, gated to supported product queries and conflict-neutral when both states appear. Existing hybrid retrieval and matcher behavior remains source-first: source query is preserved for reranking and `MatchResult.query`, with canonical alternate passed only to retrieval. OpenSpec tasks are marked 5/5 complete. No index rebuild is needed.
